entities.summary: Post-punk revival is a subgenre of indie rock, as well as a musical scene and movement that emerged in the early 2000s. Originating as a stripped-down and back-to-basics version of guitar rock inspired by the original sounds and aesthetics of post-punk, new wave and garage rock, the movement became closely associated with the new wave revival and garage rock revival. post-punk revival is a music genre, created circa 1996. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
